title: How Much of Your VLA Is kNN
abstract: arXiv:2611.13160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models now exceed 95% success on the LIBERO simulation benchmark, yet it remains unclear how much of this performance requires generalization beyond the training demonstrations. In this work, we show that retrieving nearby demonstrations and reusing their action chunks achieves a success rate of 91.7 % on LIBERO without policy training. Under LIBERO-Plus perturbations, retrieval shows the smallest drop of all evaluated policies. Across nine publicly available VLAs, fine-tuning mostly makes the vision-language backbone a better retrieval key, and the actions of the VLAs remain close to the demonstrations. In addition, we introduce Local Action Consistency (LAC), an offline metric that measures whether nearby observations in representation space are also associated with similar future actions. translated_title: 你的VLA有多少成分其实是kNN
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型目前在LIBERO仿真基准上的成功率已超过95%，但这些性能中有多少需要超越训练演示之外的泛化能力仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们证明检索近邻演示并复用其动作块，在不进行任何策略训练的情况下即可在LIBERO上达到91.7%的成功率。在LIBERO-Plus扰动下，检索方法在所有被评估的策略中表现出最小的性能下降。在九个公开可用的VLA上，微调主要使视觉-语言骨干成为更好的检索键，而VLA输出的动作仍然与演示动作十分接近。此外，我们提出了局部动作一致性，这是一种离线指标，用于衡量表示空间中的相邻观测是否也与相似的未来动作相关联。我们证明LAC能够追踪检索的成功率，并可用于指导检索键的训练。我们的评估……
tldr: 研究揭示LIBERO基准上VLA的高成功率很大程度上只是近邻演示检索的体现——无需任何训练的检索方法即可达到91.7%成功率，并提出局部动作一致性指标来衡量检索质量并指导检索键训练。
en_tdlr: Simple kNN retrieval of nearby demonstrations without any policy training achieves 91.7% success on LIBERO, revealing that VLA performance largely reflects retrieval rather than generalization, with a new Local Action Consistency (LAC) metric introduced to measure retrieval quality and guide retrieval key training.
